audit.why: TRICKY 7.5/10 against a 52.26% win rate over 1106 games is defensible — Riven wins most of laning but Aurora owns the level 6 window outright.
audit.corrected: Difficulty kept; the stage sides were the defect.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four level-chart rows disagreed with both the packet chart and this page's own whys: Level 1 was given to Aurora though whys[0] says your Q resets out-trade her, Level 2 was Skill though whys[1] says she cannot escape a stun she never cast through, Level 3 was Riven though whys[2] calls it a full-kit mirror, and First item was Riven though whys[5] literally opens 'Skill spike'.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Riven, Riven, Skill, Riven, Aurora, Skill, Riven] and matches the why text row for row. The mirror audit found the same pattern on Aurora's side and concluded the packet chart is the trustworthy one.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2 and 5 flipped as matched full/content pairs, phases whys rewritten to justify them, and phases[0].rating raised off 3/10 now that Level 1 is Riven's.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text called her Q 'Twofold Hunt', and no cooldown was given for Across the Veil or Between Worlds — the two abilities the whole gameplan is timed against.
audit.why: Riot data: Twofold Hex (Q, 9s at rank 1), Across the Veil (W, 22s at rank 1 — a very long punish window, and it is the escape the page tells you to bait), Between Worlds (R, 140s at rank 1, a slow zone she can teleport across). Naming the escape without its cooldown left the advice vague.
audit.corrected: Name corrected to Twofold Hex; Across the Veil's 22s and Between Worlds' 140s written into spikes[1], whys[1] and phases[4].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spirit Abjuration was never mentioned anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Her passive exorcises spirits from everything she damages and they heal her, so poke she lands is also sustain she banks — that is why chip trades lose to her and why Grievous Wounds timing decides extended fights.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[2] now states the passive sustain and the Executioner's Calling answer.

edits.before: Your Q resets win level 1 if you weave autos between casts. Identify how Aurora contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Your Q resets out-trade her Twofold Hex chip at Level 1 — she has no blink yet, so contest the wave and set the rhythm yourself.

edits.before: Full kit online â€” your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Aurora must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit on both sides — your combo matches her burst, but open with Ki Burst or Across the Veil takes her straight out of it.

edits.before: Blade of the Exile + the wind-slash execute turns half-HP fights lethal. Reassess every all-in at 6 â€” Aurora's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Between Worlds (140s) slows you inside her zone while she crosses it freely — at 6 she picks the fight, so hold Wind Slash for her re-entry, not her opener.

edits.before: Eclipse is your spike â€” force fights the moment it completes, on Twofold Hex's cooldown.
edits.after: Her Shadowflame and your first item cancel out — neither of you kills without landing the opener.

edits.before: With Levels 4-5 your Q cooldown tightens and your shield from E absorbs a full Twofold Hex proc — use it to force trades she cannot sustain at the wave.
edits.after: At Levels 4-5 your E shield absorbs a full Twofold Hex return — walk her down in the 22 seconds after she spends Across the Veil, which is her only exit.

edits.before: W online: E into her, W-stun before Across the Veil animates, and chain your full Q — she cannot escape a stun she never got to cast through.
edits.after: W online: E into her, Ki Burst before Across the Veil animates, then chain Q — and if she spends it, that is 22 seconds with no exit at all.

edits.before: Freeze or slow-push to keep you in poke range of her Q and deny you from getting close enough to trade with your melee kit
edits.after: Poke from range so Spirit Abjuration spirits trail back and heal her — your chip funds her sustain unless you buy Executioner's
